# Zen

Notes and [links](https://example.com) are ignored.

- `F1` Help before any heading

## Tabs
### Open & close
- `Ctrl+T` New tab
- `Ctrl+Shift+T` — Reopen closed tab
* `Ctrl+W`: Close tab

### Navigate
- `Ctrl+Tab` Next tab
- `Ctrl+1–8` Go to tab 1–8
- `` Ctrl+` `` Toggle something

## Workspaces
- `Ctrl+Alt+→` Next workspace

```text
- `Ctrl+Q` inside a code fence is ignored
```
